description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom TextView component used for displaying log data received via the LogNode interface in an Android application.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that outputs log data received through the LogNode interface, formatting log messages and appending them to its display.

methods.name: LogView
methods.description: Constructors for LogView accepting Context and optional AttributeSet and style parameters.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and outputs a log message with associated priority, tag, message, and throwable; appends the formatted log to the view and forwards it to the next LogNode in chain.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append strings to a StringBuilder with delimiter if the string is not null.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Outputs a string as a new line in the LogView display.
